_doc: PFSSOT-P2 (BI-PF-0363) grooming guidelines + cadence. Data, not code: the deterministic groomer and the AI groom prompt both read this. Owner: core/grooming.py.

cadence._note: 0 = disabled. No per-read / per-assignment AI grooming. Periodic sweep (if >0) is a scheduler job, not polling.
cadence._ai_note: controls per-entry AI enrichment for the deep groom. 'all' (default) = every on-entry item; 'high_value' = feature/architecture types only; 'deferred' = queue and groom in background.

checklist.ask: Are title, objective and acceptance criteria present and specific?
Set priority + priority_rank + MoSCoW for deterministic ordering.
Structured dependencies (BLOCKS/REQUIRES/RELATED + required_state) with the backlog.
Does equivalent work already exist in the backlog/components?
Does this conflict with settled architecture? Set drift NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH.
Concurrent tasks touching the same module/component?
Implementation strategy: which modules/APIs to extend; new component only if none fits.
What is missing that the human must decide?
